== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Guild]] Heads are the leaders of the various [[Guilds]] that serve as the foundation of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Holding some of the most prestigious and well-compensated positions within the imperial structure, these individuals possess significant political influence and are often highly respected. Some leaders are elected based on their ability to bond with a specific [[Vessel]], such as a historical weapon. The roles and responsibilities of a Head vary by organization; for instance, the leader of the [[Blackwatch]] may be responsible for carrying out executions, while the heads of the [[Witness' Guild]] serve as both [[Chroniclers]] and [[Silent Ones]]. In terms of power, many [[Guild]] Heads are exceptionally formidable. Some possess the ability to kill with a mere touch, and others are recognized as having immense strength. The leadership of certain [[Guilds]] is also tied to specific identities, such as [[Mekendi Maxeus]] leading the Guild of Magisters{{!}}Magister's Guild or [[Baldesar Kern]] heading the Champion’s Guild{{!}}Champion's Guild. While some leaders may seek to avoid the heavy political demands of interacting with other [[Guilds]], the position carries high stakes, as a leader who fails to maintain their duties may face sudden and violent removal. The stability of The Empire{{!}}the Empire is closely linked to these leaders, as they are tasked with protecting the realm from threats like the [[Elders]].}}
